创建存储过程 products_count
创建带输入参数的存储过程
commands:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE products_count_with_parm(
	OUT total INTEGER,
	IN c_id INTEGER
	)
AS 
BEGIN
	SELECT UnitsInStock INTO total
	FROM products
	WHERE CategoryID = c_id;
END;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION func_increment_sql(
  num1 IN integer, 
  num2 IN integer, 
  res OUT integer
  )
RETURN integer
AS
BEGIN
res := num1 + num2;
END;
/
